name: Ring Flyer
summary:
This is the moment you’ve been waiting for: a chance to prove you’re ready for the big leagues. So strap on your gear and make your way to the nearest spaceport. You’ll be greeted by your flight instructor, Bailey, who will show you the basics of how to pilot a space plane. But really, it’s all on you. Only nerves of steel and a steady hand will get you through this elite training course!

Ring Flyer features ten levels and three difficulty levels for your Nuon DVD system. It starts off easy, but then the rings start moving! Look ahead and anticipate where the next ring will be. Boost your score by hitting every ring and completing each level on the first try. Will you achieve the rank of ace pilot?
